current_summary: B65/B66 confirm Q7.L-R19.1 and Q7.R-R19.2 at 1.5 ohm. B67-B70 diode readings R->L 0.74 V, L->R 1.74 V, S->L 0.74 V, L->S OL support a PNP structure with L as base. R=emitter/S=collector remains the 3GW/BC857C datasheet-and-circuit assignment, not uniquely determined by these fitted-device diode tests. Exact maker/part and powered behavior remain open; earlier R19 0/4.5 V conflicts with simple healthy PNP behavior.
interpretation: Two 0.74 V paths with black on QL support the proposed PNP/common-base polarity. Reverse QL->QR=1.74 V can arise through R19 or other fitted-board paths; its origin is not isolated. It does not establish a short, reverse breakdown, or damage. Diode tests alone do not distinguish emitter from collector or prove exact part identity, gain, load capability or correct powered operation.
next_action: No repeat Q7 diode/continuity/DC check now. Move to E03 Q8 gate-source voltages. Receiver enabled-state behavior remains an explicit later issue.

candidate_source.basis: Rev9 Table3 B=1/E=2/C=3; Table5 BC857C marking 3G plus site code; Table8 ordinary conducting VBE about -0.6 to -0.75 V at its stated test point. The datasheet does not identify the fitted part by itself.
